description: Remove the ugly _card() box-drawing system and revert all format functions to the original clean style using _SEP separators and title headers. Also add AI Support feature and fix code issues.
steps: STEP 1 - Remove _card() system: Delete the `_CARD_W = 24` constant (line 1852) and the `_card()` function definition (lines 1854-1866). Keep `_progress_bar()`, `_mini_chart()`, `_status_dot()` as they are useful. Remove `_quick_actions_inline()` and `_responsive_kb()` functions since they are not needed for reply-keyboard-only approach (though _responsive_kb is used, so keep it if called elsewhere).
STEP 3 - Rewrite fmt_balance_screen to simple style: Remove _card() call. Use f"💰 My Balance {_SEP} 👤 {name} 🆔 ID: {id} ... {_SEP} Status: ..." pattern.
STEP 5 - Rewrite fmt_product_detail: Replace _card() with simple title + _SEP + body pattern.
STEP 6 - Rewrite fmt_service_detail: Replace _card() with simple title + _SEP + body pattern.
STEP 7 - Rewrite fmt_order_history: Replace _card() with simple '📜 Order History\n{_SEP}\n' + lines pattern. Handle empty case with simple message.
STEP 8 - Rewrite fmt_deposit_history: Replace _card() with simple '💳 Deposit History\n{_SEP}\n' + lines pattern.
STEP 9 - Rewrite fmt_admin_dashboard: Replace _card() with simple '📊 Admin Dashboard\n{_SEP}\n' + body pattern.
STEP 10 - Rewrite fmt_analytics: Replace _card() with simple '📈 Sales Analytics\n{_SEP}\n' + body pattern.
STEP 11 - Fix the two inline _card() calls in admin dashboard handler (line 5816 for low stock alert and line 5849 for stock overview): Replace with simple f-string format using _SEP.

STEP 12 - Add AI Support feature: Add a new button BTN_AI_SUPPORT = _b('🤖 AI Support') in the user button definitions (around line 660). Add it to main_menu_kb() alongside BTN_SUPPORT. Add a new FSM state for AI support in UserFlow class. Create a handler that shows a menu of FAQ topics as a reply keyboard: 'How to Buy', 'How to Deposit', 'Check Stock', 'Referral Info', 'My Orders', '2FA Help', 'Mail Codes', 'Ask a Question'. Each topic button shows a pre-written answer. The 'Ask a Question' option lets user type freely, and simple keyword matching provides answers.

STEP 13 - Code audit and fixes: Check for any broken references, dead handler states, buttons not wired to handlers. Specifically verify _quick_actions_inline is used properly (only in admin dashboard which is fine). Remove _CARD_W constant. Ensure all fmt_* functions are consistent with simple style.
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())" passes with no errors
No box-drawing characters (╔═╗║╚╝╠╣) remain in any fmt_* function
All fmt_* functions use _SEP-based simple formatting with title pattern
AI Support button exists in main_menu_kb()
AI Support handler responds to FAQ topics with pre-written answers
Keyword matching in 'Ask a Question' handles common queries about buy, deposit, stock, referral, vip
No syntax errors in the final file
verification: grep -c '╔\|╗\|║\|╚\|╝\|╠\|╣' bot.py should return 0 (no box-drawing in code logic, only maybe in the file header comment which is fine to keep or remove)
grep -c 'BTN_AI_SUPPORT' bot.py should return at least 3 (definition, menu, handler)
grep -c 'AI Support' bot.py should return at least 1
findings: All _card() usages removed and replaced with clean _SEP-based formatting. _responsive_kb removed as unused. AI Support fully implemented with FAQ topics and keyword matching. Box-drawing characters only remain in file header comments (cosmetic, not in any fmt_ function). All acceptance criteria verified passing. Post-review fixes applied: (1) keyword matching now uses re.search with word boundaries to prevent substring false positives, (2) ai_free_question no-match path stays in ai_support_ask state for consistent UX, (3) main menu pairs BTN_SUPPORT and BTN_AI_SUPPORT on same row with BTN_MORE alone.
